name: Tessera Industries Compact Evidence Destroyer CED-2
product_name: Tessera Industries Compact Evidence Destroyer CED-2
description: A portable device that destroys physical evidence and electronic data with a combination of thermite incineration and electromagnetic pulse. The CED-2 has two compartments — a thermite chamber that incinerates physical items at 2,500°C, and an EMP generator that permanently destroys electronic data on any device placed within its field. The device is single-use and reduces its contents to unrecoverable ash and magnetically wiped circuits in under 5 seconds. Tessera markets it as a 'classified material destruction system' for authorized disposal of sensitive materials.

specifications.info: 2; 500°C incineration; permanent data wipe; neural interface authorization

story_hooks: A CED-2 was activated at a crime scene, destroying all physical and electronic evidence in one 5-second burst — investigators arrived to find a pile of ash and the melted remains of the CED-2 itself.
A CED-2 has been modified with a timer and concealed in a filing cabinet — it is set to destroy the cabinet's contents at a specific time, and finding it before activation requires knowing it exists.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, militaristic rectangular box with a hinged top access panel. The form factor suggests serious industrial purpose — all hard angles and thermal-resistant casing. Visually resembles a high-end portable safe crossed with lab equipment. No unnecessary styling; pure functional brutalism.
physical_description.weight_description: 2 kg — handheld but requires two hands for sustained carrying; fits in a tactical bag with effort
physical_description.primary_material: Titanium-composite external shell with thermal-resistant ceramic lining visible through side vents
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal with heat-stress discoloration patterns (browns, purples) across the upper thermite chamber section from previous use cycles. Deliberate wear aesthetic — this is a tool, not show
physical_description.color_scheme: Dark gunmetal gray primary; burnt copper and charcoal accents around ventilation grilles; neon-orange warning stripe along the hinge edge
physical_description.interface_elements: Two recessed pushbuttons (red and black) mounted flush on the top face; small neural-link contact pad (3mm circular, silver-toned) center-mounted for authorization handshake; dual exhaust ports with thermal louvers on rear; hinged front access panel with magnetic closure
distinctive_features: Faint scorch marks and thermal bloom patterns across the upper half indicating active use
Ventilation grilles that glow faintly orange/red when thermal chamber is active
Recessed button wells to prevent accidental activation
Neural-link contact pad with subtle status LED that cycles blue-to-amber during authorization
Magnetic closure latch that clicks with satisfying mechanical precision
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Tessera Industries logo (geometric T in chrome) stamped on top; 'VASQUEZ BIOCOMPATIBLE MATERIALS' etched below in small sans-serif; serial number and batch code on rear panel; regulatory disposal codes in micro-print; warning triangle with thermite and EMP symbols
physical_description.condition_typical: Micro-scratches and handling wear on edges; subtle carbon scoring on the thermal vents; neural-pad may show faint discoloration from repeated bioelectric contact. Despite rugged appearance, unit maintains pristine internal precision — user-facing surfaces show evidence of professional handling
